title: Atelier Shallie Plus: Alchemists of the Dusk Sea

info.about: Atelier Shallie: Alchemists of the Dusk Sea is a 2014 Japanese role-playing video game developed by Gust for the PlayStation 3. It is the 16th main entry in Gust's Atelier series and is currently the final installment of the Dusk trilogy.
